versus.New Relic: Targets Datadog buyers with five Datadog-named pages. Datadog has no comparison pages, and updated no old pages, versus New Relic's 15.
versus.Dynatrace: Out-publishes Datadog, 69 new pages to 36, and also updates old pages and runs research. Datadog did neither this period.
versus.Splunk: Published nothing new this period, while Datadog added 36 pages, including a guide to migrate Splunk queries and alerts to Datadog.
versus.Grafana Labs: Publishes 8 comparison pages and AI agent tool comparisons. None in this data names Datadog, which has no comparison pages itself.
versus.Elastic Observability: Much smaller, with 18 new pages mostly on security, government and release notes. Datadog covers far more observability how-tos.
versus.Sumo Logic: Leans on DojoAI security and agent news, with 8 new pages. Datadog has more hands-on guides and customer stories.
